governance_items.title: Leaked Supabase Cloud Credentials in Historical Git Commits
governance_items.rationale: Historical commits 9305ab5c, 34b7d2c7, and 5e515195 contain hardcoded Supabase API keys for project ynkdnwhubfknnnzjtpeg. Governed by Rule R5: Human rotation in Supabase Console followed by git-filter-repo. Documented in .gsd/MANUAL_ACTIONS.md.

governance_items.title: Absence of Clear-Site-Data Header on Session Logout
governance_items.rationale: Client invokes supabase.auth.signOut() immediately invalidating refresh token and server session. Defense-in-depth header recommendation.
